places.name: Santiago, Chile
places.description: My first business trip and also first time I visited a different country.

places.name: São Paulo, Brazil
places.description: Been there twice. Largest city of Brazil and of South America.

places.name: Tenerife, Spain
places.description: Visited IAC. We took a day to visit the El Teide volcano. Amazing place.

places.name: Copenhagen, Denmark
places.description: A city for those who love riding bikes. Visited the hippie neighborhood, that was super cool.

places.name: New York, USA
places.description: Absolutely unique experience. Went there on a business trip, and visited the Flatiron Institute.

places.name: Stockholm, Sweden
places.description: Lived there for 6 months. Has a special place in my heart. Very cold place, but still the best city mobility I have ever seen.

places.name: Lisbon, Portugal
places.description: Stayed there for only a couple of days in a connection. Would like to come back someday.

places.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
places.description: Visited Christ the Redeemer. Amazing city, certainly will come back.

places.name: Rome, Italy
places.description: Been there multiple times. For those who love travelling, it is a must.

places.name: Munich, Germany
places.description: First time in Germany. Visited the castle of Cinderella. Quite nice city.

places.name: Ghent, Belgium
places.description: Small city but very beautiful. Best Christmas market we've seen in Belgium.

places.name: Brussels, Belgium
places.description: Spent my Christmas there. It was super cold, but the city is wonderful.

places.name: Antwerp, Belgium
places.description: City of diamonds. We stayed at a very good hotel there.

places.name: Paris, France
places.description: Beautiful city. Visited the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre.

places.name: Turin, Italy
places.description: Travelled there for my birthday. Really liked the city, had a great time.

places.name: Itacaré, Brazil
places.description: Beautiful beaches. Participated in HUB 2026 there.

places.name: Barcelona, Spain
places.description: Absolutely amazing city. Full of architecture and art.

places.name: Pisa, Italy
places.description: They have a funny tower there
